title: Modified CTAB Method for RNA Extraction from Conifer Plants
author: Clarissa Lopez Del Visco
materials: Carefully remove and discard the ETOH.

steps.title: Sterilize mortar and pestle
steps.instruction: Autoclave the mortar and pestle before use and plan to work in batches of 12–24 samples.

steps.title: Prepare frozen tissue
steps.instruction: Take frozen samples from the –80 °C freezer, place them on ice or a cool rack, and inside the chemical hood add 20 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (2.67 %) to each tube.

steps.title: Add warm CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat the CTAB extraction buffer to 65 °C (preheat a water bath and a dry thermal bath to 65 °C), then add 750 µL of the warm CTAB buffer to each sample.

steps.title: Grind tissue to powder
steps.instruction: In a sterilized mortar, place the frozen tissue, add liquid nitrogen, and grind with a pestle until a very fine powder is obtained, adding LN₂ as needed to keep the sample cold. Transfer the powder to a sterile screw‑cap 15 mL tube and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Mix and incubate
steps.instruction: Invert the tubes gently to mix (do not shake). Incubate in a dry thermal bath at 65 °C for 10 min, inverting once after 5 min.

steps.title: First CHISAM wash
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) (CHISAM) to each tube, invert gently (no shaking), then centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 20 min at room temperature. Transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Second CHISAM wash
steps.instruction: Add another 750 µL CHISAM to each tube, invert gently, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 20 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: LiCl precipitation overnight
steps.instruction: Add 1/4 volume of 10 M LiCl to each tube, place the tubes in a styrofoam box on ice, then move the box to a 4 °C freezer or cold room and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend in SSTE
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a water bath and a heat block to 60 °C, heat the SSTE buffer to 60 °C, and cool the centrifuge to 4 °C. Centrifuge the samples at 10,000 rpm for 30 min at 4 °C. Add 700 µL warm SSTE buffer, pipet‑mix to resuspend the pellet (pellet may be brown, faint, or invisible).

steps.title: Third CHISAM wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL CHISAM, incubate at 60 °C for 5–10 min, invert gently, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Fourth CHISAM wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL CHISAM, centrifuge at 4,500 rpm for 10 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of cold absolute ethanol to each tube, then incubate at –80 °C for 1 hour (use this time to prepare gels for RNA visualization).

steps.title: Pellet spin and water elution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 30 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and add 25–50 µL DEPC‑treated water to the dry pellet. Keep the tube on ice or a cold rack.

steps.title: 70 % ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 700 µL cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 2 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, repeat a second wash, then air‑dry the pellet in the hood (use a P20 pipette to remove excess ethanol).

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store the resuspended RNA at –80 °C (optional: assess concentration/quality with Nanodrop, Qubit, or Bioanalyzer).

steps.title: DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Dilute the RNA to a total volume of 100 µL (e.g., add water to reach 100 µL; aim for ≥1000 ng total RNA). Add 1 µL DNase of choice and 10 µL 10× DNase buffer, then incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL (2× volume) SPRI beads, vortex briefly, spin down, and incubate at room temperature for at least 5 min.

steps.title: Magnetic bead capture
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 min until the solution is clear. Gently move the tube to gather all beads against the side, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: First ethanol wash of beads
steps.instruction: With the tubes still on the magnet, add 200 µL 80 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 2 min, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash of beads
steps.instruction: Repeat the 80 % ethanol wash (add 200 µL ethanol, incubate 2 min, discard supernatant).

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads for 3–5 min until no visible liquid remains (cracks appear in the bead pellet).

steps.title: Elute RNA from beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried beads in 32 µL RNase‑free water, incubate at room temperature for 2 min, place on the magnet until the supernatant is clear, and transfer 30 µL of the supernatant (purified RNA) to a new tube.

steps.title: Final mix
steps.instruction: Invert the final RNA tube gently to mix (do not shake).
